input.body: I want to pursue a funded particle-physics PhD focused on detector reconstruction, uncertainty estimation, or computational methods. My preparation includes a Bachelor of Science in Physics from the University of Lagos and research experience as a research assistant at CERN OpenLab, where I work on uncertainty calibration for charged-particle track reconstruction. My undergraduate project was a Monte Carlo study of muon-background rejection in a compact scintillator detector. I use Python, C++, ROOT and Geant4. I was awarded the 2023 Faculty Research Prize. I am seeking full tuition support and a living stipend.
